In 1875 Senator Witt came to Arkansas and settled at Quitman, Van Buren county. In 1881 he moved to Montgomery county and made his residence at the county seat, Mount Ida. Senator Witt has since continually resided at Mount Ida. He was elected to the legislature as a repre sentative from Montgomery county in 1889. He served the term with great credit to himself and was returned by his constituents in 1891. items.title: Crystal Campground - Ouachita National Forest, Arkansas (47476076432)
items.desc: A campground at the Crystal Recreation Area along Collier Springs Road in the Ouachita National Forest in Arkansas. It is certainly a beautiful setting, especially in springtime, and I was surprised to find it completely empty. It's free, but no electric and no water. Vault toilet. There's no cell service here on AT&T, Verizon, or T-Mobile, but drive a few minutes west, and you'll be back on the grid.
items.credit: Tony Webster from Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States

items.credit: MODIS Land Rapid Response Team, NASA GSFC
